stations.title: Ossian
stations.say: How many did the Gannet sell today?

stations.title: Ticket stubs
stations.text: A pile of stubs, one boat name on each

captions: The ticket hut at evening. Ossian wants the day's tickets counted for each boat.
Today he counts a pile of stubs by hand, and the tally reads differently every night.
You count tickets in a map, print it in the boats' order, and look up any sailing.
Now every boat's tickets are counted, and the report reads the same each night.
A tally that counts itself. Next: a gangway that remembers every ticket.
